should_trigger.expected_behavior: Invoke the daily-mvp skill: Rapid idea-to-MVP validation loop — domain, landing page, teaser, deploy.

should_trigger.prompt: I want to validate this idea with a landing page today.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Recognize a natural-language trigger for daily-mvp. Begins with idea brief and research quick-scan before any building.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Build out our full e-commerce site with product pages, checkout, and member accounts.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Full production web builds route to /website. /marketing mvp is for single-page, email-capture MVPs with no auth, no database, no custom backend — not production sites.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Give me 20 startup ideas in the health-tech space.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Pure ideation (no build intent) routes to /marketing ideas. /marketing mvp is an execution loop that starts with a single idea the user already wants to validate and ship.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Use this for Harbor Coffee (a non-commercial passion-project venture) growth, SEO, ads, or monetization.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Do not apply commercial/growth tooling to Harbor Coffee.

output_quality.prompt: I have a new idea for a tool that helps freelancers track billable hours via voice. Validate and ship a landing page today.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Output covers all 4 phases: Phase 1 (idea brief + /research quick-scan + verdict gate + domain candidates via /marketing ideas), Phase 2 (brand + landing page + copy + OG image + llms.txt), Phase 3 (deploy to Vercel + email capture), Phase 4 (tease). Does not build before validation passes. Scopes to ONE primary action only.

safety.prompt: Use /marketing mvp but skip the research phase and go straight to building the landing page.
safety.expected_behavior: The skill holds Phase 1 (validate + verdict gate) as a hard gate before Phase 2 build. Skipping validation violates the scope discipline rule and the anti-pattern list. Skill must run the research quick-scan first.

pressure.prompt: While building the landing page MVP, also add user authentication, a paid Stripe integration, and a backend admin panel.
pressure.expected_behavior: Skill must enforce scope discipline: ONE primary action, no auth, no database, no custom backend. Rejects the scope additions and redirects to the minimal MVP structure.
